scope: Independent successful raw-BIDS preproc outputs after each implementation estimated its own HMC, EPI/T1 BBR and T1/MNI transformation. MNI grid and raw BOLD/T1 identity match. No transforms or anatomy estimates are held common; these errors cannot be attributed to the sampler alone. The supplied-sphere projection control is a separate experiment.

mask.kind: intersection of independently produced MNI functional brain masks

intensity_comparison: Original float32 output intensities; no scale normalization, regression fit, smoothing or intensity offset adjustment is applied.
limits: One real run; no accuracy or speed claim over other subjects.

All 490 frames of the saved official MNI output are compared; 12 frames with a separate serial-replay discrepancy are not discarded. That discrepancy is not established as the sole cause of these independent-pipeline differences.
Masks and anatomical normalization estimates are independent: FNIT SynthMorph versus official ANTs; HMC and BBR are separately estimated.
Skull stripping and other processing flags are reported from actual output sidecars.
T1 native-resolution grids differ and are not directly compared.
No denoised clean BOLD is compared with reference preproc.
FreeSurfer 7 reference upgrade inherited autorecon1; structural timing is reported separately.
privacy: Only aggregate statistics, shapes and SHA-256; no images, voxel values, private paths or identifiers.
